question: The plans show a college cafe before and after a redesign. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.
question_transcription: Task1 college-cafe prompt is a locator; authoritative visual and instructions remain in the source image.
essay: The maps give information on the layout of a college cafe before and after being redesigned. Overall, there have been many changes made to the cafe, with the most noticeable ones being the addition of a new outdoor seating area and the reorganization of the food service area into dedicated sections. As for the indoor area, before the redesign, upon entering the cafe via the double door located in the top-right corner of the layout, visitors could immediately see the two staff dining rooms. These have been converted into a take-away food section and a coffee bar. There was a single bin to the left of the entrance, and toilets in the corner, while tables and chairs were placed in the middle of the building.
